script_text: Pisces, your ruling planet Neptune is sending a major wake-up call this week that changes everything. As a Water sign guided by Neptune, Monday through Wednesday finds the Sun traversing your 8th House in Libra, stirring suppressed emotions. Mars forms a tense square to your ruling Neptune from the 2nd House, creating financial pressure and testing your self-worth. Wednesday transforms everything as the Sun enters Scorpio, flowing into your 9th House of higher learning and adventure. Thursday through Sunday, Venus trines Jupiter in your 5th House, igniting romance and creativity. Weekend energy supports bold moves in love. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun enters your 9th House of expansion. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars squares Neptune in your 2nd House, triggering money stress. Set clear financial boundaries early so you embrace love when the Venus-Jupiter trine arrives. Follow for daily updates.
